verdict.rationale: A UI framework could publish a machine-readable description of its API, such as type definitions or an AI-oriented reference, so this axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec for SolidJS. TypeScript integration is mentioned only as a build tool and does not count as a published, downloadable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
